shared_suffix: Extreme close-up macro photo, shallow depth of field, soft warm light, rich true colors, sharp, cinematic, no text, no watermark, no people's faces.
negative: text, letters, numbers, logo, license plate, watermark, cartoon, illustration, miniature, blurry, low quality, deformed hands, faces

shots.prompt: A car wheel and tire close-up on clean asphalt, glossy paint above it.
shots.motion: The wheel turns slowly, light rolls across the rim. Cinematic slow motion, 120 fps look, the camera barely drifts closer. Soft ambient sound.

shots.prompt: A car headlight close-up, clean glass.
shots.motion: The headlight switches on and glows, slow motion. Cinematic slow motion, 120 fps look, the camera barely drifts closer. Soft ambient sound.

shots.prompt: Sunlight reflecting on glossy car paint, a water droplet on the surface.
shots.motion: A water droplet slides slowly down the paint. Cinematic slow motion, 120 fps look, the camera barely drifts closer. Soft ambient sound.
